pi-abc7c890a4774345a8b439c9903721a7.name: 6698.pdf
pi-abc7c890a4774345a8b439c9903721a7.description: The complete text of Turkey's Personal Data Protection Law (No. 6698, Official Gazette 7/4/2016), encompassing its purpose, scope, definitions, data processing principles and conditions, data subject rights, enforcement and complaint procedures, criminal and administrative penalties, and the establishment and structure of the Personal Data Protection Authority.

pi-17ad91c85edb4b36b210d42c9afeb9f1.name: 6502.pdf
pi-17ad91c85edb4b36b210d42c9afeb9f1.description: A comprehensive January 2021 compilation published by Turkey's Ministry of Commerce containing the full text of Consumer Protection Law No. 6502 together with all its associated secondary legislation, including regulations on unfair contract terms, installment sales, consumer credit, housing finance, distance and off-premises contracts, timeshare and package travel, warranty and after-sales services, commercial advertising, consumer arbitration boards, refurbished product sales, and 2021 administrative fine schedules.

pi-30817bfb202c4a89b4a98fc904dc95ba.name: 2547.pdf
pi-30817bfb202c4a89b4a98fc904dc95ba.description: The complete text of Turkey's Higher Education Law (Law No. 2547, 1981), comprehensively governing the structure, governance, and operations of all higher education institutions in Turkey, including the Council of Higher Education (YÖK), university and faculty organizational hierarchies, academic personnel appointments and ranks, student education and admission rules, financial and revolving fund provisions, disciplinary procedures for staff and students, foundation (vakıf) university regulations, and a full record of legislative amendments from 1982 through 2024.
